ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The right side of the figure is labeled Structure B. The central atom of Structure B is S, connected to four O around it; between the left and right two O and S there is one single line each, indicating two S–O single bonds; between the upper and lower two O and S there are two lines each, indicating two S=O double bonds. Reasoning: The bond order of a single bond is 1, and the bond order of a double bond is 2. In Structure B, the bond orders of the four S–O bonds are respectively 1, 1, 2, 2, therefore the average S–O bond order = (1 + 1 + 2 + 2) / 4 = 1.5.
